notes.title: Name Change & Full Release Update
notes.content:
WELCOME TO SCP: GROUND ZERO!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/1dc47d68b1168406cb3f3e79505f3445513ea739.gif

We've decided we'll be changing our official name on Steam after full release sometime this year.
This is to directly counter the old version of the game which was very similar to other SCP games of that time. 

[previewyoutube=tM3hqg3ORxY;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are some expected changes in the full release:

Gamemodes
The 5 new gamemodes allow for varied gameplay - are you looking for a shooting gallery? We have it. Are you looking for a horror experience? It's there. And finally, are you looking for an SCP FPS about infiltrating the facility itself? We have that too.
And if you're interested, there's also a mode where you can spawn in any item or enemy and do as you wish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/4ab0a7c5d6c6cbac8d12d139203daabca8490ee8.png

Point is, this should allow for much more varied ways to play the game!


Facility Generation
This one's obvious, now facilities will generate randomly for more replayable gameplay. This also means some story elements, items and enemies will also be random!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/4ed1437b1036e2a358071fee6289dc9dc08df901.png

You can also set a seed or use a random one which means sharing layouts will be quick and easy!


New Enemies
Meet the Cobras! Mobile Task Force unit designated Charlie-9, a highly trained and highly armed branch of MTF designed specifically to protect Area-14 (Which is our new location).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/e518402c6b7a70c6546fe9b636d4b9dfadbe169d.png

They will be quite a challenge, they won't go alone, they'll hunt you down and they'll be watching your every step.
We haven't forgotten about SCPs either, all SCP will be reworked to be harder and smarter adversaries.


New Combat
What better way to kill the previously mentioned new enemies than with a new arsenal of weapons!
Previously, we only had a pistol. Now, our arsenal includes Shotguns, Rifles, Railguns, Flamethrowers and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/c13f6e95db052b699aede4c179529c920325f07b.png

These weapons will be extremely useful against the new SCP enemies too!


So Much More!
New characters, environments, optimising, gameplay, sound improvements and so much more!


Note that the name will only be changed AFTER the update has released.

We hope to see you at the release of this new update and please tell us your opinions!
-Nikk F
Lead Developer


Big Thanks to Minirow for all the help!

notes.title: Full Release Progress
notes.content:
What's Been Going On?
We haven't posted any updates almost all year and we've heard people say the game is abandoned. That is in no way the case! The update is taking us a long time since we really want to make the most content possible. New guns, locations, graphical improvements, optimisations, story elements etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/a7deb03423b2aa1eae9d21945caa69cfde221891.png
We've been focusing a lot on making the combat unique and fun but also staying within the lines of the SCP lore and, of course, making sure the SCPs are still terrifying.

Short Combat Teaser
[previewyoutube=ZCb6EUGVLG8;full][/previewyoutube]
Raw, uncut gameplay of a short battle within Light Containment against Special Forces.
We've tried to make the AI advanced to actually pose a threat - they'll talk to other members about where you are, if you're hiding, they'll investigate sounds they hear etc.

Tell Us Your Opinion!
What do you think of the update thus far? What should be added or changes?
(Keep in mind, saving is already a feature, so no need to mention it)
Any ideas are greatly appreciated!

We'll post more announcements but we encourage you to join our discord server for the most info and teasers and to tell us what you think!
SCP: Nukalypse Discord

Thank you for reading and for your patience,
We hope to see you soon!

-Nikk
Lead Developer

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 News
notes.content:
Hello!

We wanted to make a quick announcement about the progress of our newest update! Currently, our plan is to stray further from other games similar to this one and work on improving gameplay and optimisation. As of now, we have many core features added and lots of exciting stuff to come such as:


NEW GAMEPLAY ELEMENTS
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/347b6cd02e86c6d38582485f965d35f3fa8fd7fa.png
These new gameplay changes and areas are accompanied by a variety of new exciting puzzles and challenges which will hopefully increase overall game-time but also increase general diversity in gameplay since, as of now, the game is very "monotone". We've negated this by making the game a lot more focus on combat!(More on that below)

BETTER MOVEMENT / MOBILITY
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/4d8ad8e2a1a5ff6219b82cc6fcbe79f5c056d5b6.png
With this new gameplay style we've implemented ventilation shafts that the player can crawl through to get to new locations, complete puzzles or get an advantage on the enemies! (And yes, the enemies are human!)


NEW ENEMIES
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/892d8530e7aee8a9990168ca00ed0284f95e99c4.png
We won't get too in-depth with the human enemies as they are still being worked on, but they should act as initial enemies the player faces and the real threat, apart from the SCPs, of course.


NEW COMBAT
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33665062/d4f3cc41ffd4d29bbbbe7f0cc9a548cb6727ad57.png
These new changes allow us to make combat fun. Before, you could find a pistol, but it was ultimately useless since it would switch your flashlight which you need to see and had limited bullets. Plus, SCPs don't usually care if you're shooting them, which made the guns useless. 
With these new enemies, you can expect exciting firefights to take place throughout the facility - You decide the outcome.


We hope to release this update soon, but we still don't have a set date in time, which is why we decided to notify everyone that we are still, in fact, improving the game!

If you have any questions or want to report a bug, join our discord server!
https://discord.gg/dfxAkA2

Thank you for reading,
-Nikk
Lead Programmer

notes.title: Final Update Before Release
notes.content:
Hello!

Thank you very much for following this project and its progress. We are getting closer by the day to the release. We don't want to give a specific date yet, but we plan on releasing version 0.1.0 sometime in April.

We want to make sure the game has as little bugs as possible and as much content as we can put in it right now.

Until the game is released, this is the final update.
We hope to see you play the game, if you have any questions or want to discuss anything about the game, feel free to join our discord server!
Server invite: https://discord.gg/Zc666jd

-Nikk
Lead developer
